description.p: Chirp Wallpaper sets the daily Bing picture as your desktop background, in 4K, and tells the story behind it: where it was taken, what makes the place special and who took the photo. GNOME shows the same picture on the lock screen.

ul.li: Today’s picture with title, place, copyright and a short text you can select and copy
History of the last days: pick a favourite and keep it for a week
Picture region decides the picture and the language of its texts
Runs in the background and changes the picture every day, if you like
Nothing changes when you are offline

description.p: Chirp Wallpaper is not affiliated with Microsoft. Pictures and texts come from Bing and belong to their photographers.

Chirp Wallpaper setzt das tägliche Bing-Bild als Desktop-Hintergrund, in 4K, und erzählt die Geschichte dahinter: wo es aufgenommen wurde, was den Ort besonders macht und wer das Foto gemacht hat. GNOME zeigt dasselbe Bild auf dem Sperrbildschirm.
